results.description:
Proloquo4Text™ is a text to speech app for those who cannot rely on their voice to speak. The app is laid out on a single screen to reduce the effort of typing. The layout enables easy, daily conversation and quick access to your most common phrases. Personalize it to your needs and preferences, whether that’s through choosing from the many voices available, or through customizing your screen layout. 

Proloquo4Text is the leading AAC solution for literate adults, teens and children. It is used by people with a wide range of diagnoses, including developmental disabilities (like autism, apraxia, and cerebral palsy) and acquired disorders  (like laryngectomy, ALS, stroke, or traumatic brain injury). Proloquo4Text can be used to produce speech by anyone who can type and spell.

Communicate with ease
• Use the single screen for easy access to words, phrases and keyboard
• Switch easily between conversations, making it easy to answer a question in another conversation, without disrupting what you typed in the first conversation. 
• Decide when you speak with play, pause and speak-as-you-type
• Adjust appearance (font, color, text size) to your preference and needs

Reduce typing effort
• Create, save and organize commonly used phrases 
• Make typing quicker with advanced, self-learning PolyPredix™ word prediction 
• Show what you typed with the fullscreen view and flip text features 
• Type once, then say it again with history and sentence prediction
• Use keyboard shortcuts for quick access when using an external keyboard 

Choose your voice
• Download, natural-sounding voices within Proloquo4Text. All premium Acapela voices are included in Proloquo4Text with no in-app purchase.
• Add personality and humor to your conversations with free specialty voices
• Choose from over 100 voices in 18 languages, so you can find the one that sounds most like you. Switch easily between languages.  
• Use my-own-voice, a voice-banking technology, to preserve and capture the essence of your own voice in synthetic speech.

Share your world
• Send email, messages, and tweets from Proloquo4Text
• Write in Proloquo4Text and copy your text into another app
• Listen to text by pasting into Proloquo4Text
• Make phone and FaceTime video calls with Proloquo4Text.

Take your voice anywhere
• Proloquo4Text is available on both iOS and macOS. With iOS, you can use the app on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. The Mac version is a separate purchase on the Mac App Store.  
• Smoothly transition between devices, thanks to Proloquo4Text’s consistent navigation on iPhone and iPad
• Easily access your commonly used phrases on Apple Watch, and just tap to show or speak them. You can customize the contents shown on the Watch from your iPhone. 

Accessibility features 
• Follow words as they are spoken with optional sentence or word highlighting
• Optimized for Switch Control and VoiceOver 
• Communicate without an internet connection
• Use multitasking functionality to run another app side-by-side on supported devices
• Keep your devices in sync by easily backing up and restoring your customizations and stored phrases.  

AssistiveWare® is the developer of Proloquo2Go®, an award-winning symbol-based communication app that provides a voice to over 200,000 individuals around the world.

Additional note:
Educational institutions can get a 50% discount if they purchase 20 or more licenses through Apple’s Volume Purchase Program for Education.

Quillbot for Safari is a free writing assistant currently helping over 35 million people perfect their communication.

How it works: Install Quillbot for Safari in your browser for free. You’ll see a widget in the bottom right corner everywhere you write where you can access Quillbot’s Paraphraser, Grammar Checker, and other AI writing tools. 

Privacy and data safety: By installing the extension, you agree to the Quillbot Terms of Service and acknowledge reading the Quillbot Privacy Policy.

Key features: 

AI Text Cursor
- Place your cursor anywhere you communicate to receive instant writing, summarizing, or paraphrasing suggestions for Quillbot’s AI
- Enhance, rewrite, or clarify full sentences and paragraphs
- Write new text or change existing text with generative AI
- Use multiple tools like Grammar Checker or Paraphraser wherever you write
- Also supports emoji, GIPHY, and translations

Grammar Checker
- Check grammar, spelling, punctuation, all with one tool
- Address multiple issues at once with Quillbot’s “Fix All” button
- Find out your writing’s sentiment score and word count
- Write in English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, and Portuguese; this tool supports them all

Paraphraser
- Rephrase sentences to find the perfect way to express any idea
- Double-click for synonyms and to access our AI text cursor
- Free users get 2 modes in English and 1 mode in other languages, as well as sneak peeks of Premium recommendations
- Premium users unlock all 10 modes in English and 9 modes for non-English

AI Text Generation
- Generate sentences, paragraphs, or entire sections automatically
- Elaborate on ideas to continue writing when stuck
- Draft content quickly or overcome writer’s block everywhere you write.

Fix All Errors
Instantly fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation errors with one click

And more!


What the Extension does
Quillbot for Safari is an AI writing assistant that helps people write clearly, confidently, and quickly, directly in your browser.

- Enhance, rewrite, or generate text wherever you type with no extra tabs
- Draft polished emails, create with clarity, and overcome writer’s block instantly
- Perfect for professionals, creators, students, and multilingual writers 


Why Quillbot?
Our tool works seamlessly wherever you write in Safari, delivering a user-friendly interface, multilingual support, and unmatched accuracy to increase productivity. Our comprehensive writing tools are secure and private, so you can feel confident your data is protected across platforms.

Free users get:
- AI Text Cursor
- 2 paraphrasing modes (Standard and Fluency)
- Spelling, punctuation, and Grammar corrections
- Multilingual support (English, French, Spanish, German and Dutch)
- Multidialectal support (US, UK, CA, AU, and more)

Quillbot also offers a Premium tier, which unlocks more paraphrasing modes, extended character limits, tone insights, and full access to clarity and fluency recommendations, our Fix All button, and even more paraphrasing modes. 

Join over 35 million writers using Quillbot today.

Text Scanner (OCR) is the most accurate AI-powered image-to-text scanner app for iOS. It can extract and recognize text from images, photos, screenshots, and PDFs with 99%+ accuracy in 92 languages, and translate the extracted text into over 100 languages.

PDF Scanner - Scan physical documents and convert them into clean, professional PDFs using smart edge detection and auto-crop.

AI OCR - Attach an image or PDF and chat with AI to ask questions, summarize content, or translate text instantly.

Features:

• Extract text from images in the gallery or captured using the camera
• Image to text converter — get editable text to copy, share, or translate
• Scan documents and convert them into PDFs
• Attach images or PDFs and ask AI directly:
• Import PDFs and extract text from PDF files
• Handwriting to text conversion
• Translate text into over 100 languages
• Copy text from any screen, website, or app by sharing a screenshot
• Extract text and detect phone numbers, emails, and URLs
• Select text in multiple columns from images
• Read extracted text aloud with text-to-speech
• Edit, copy, share, and translate recognized text
• Export extracted text as searchable PDFs (with text layer)
• Export extracted text as PDF or TXT files
• Convert extracted text to PDF or Word files
• Select multiple images and convert them into a single PDF
• Crop and rotate images before OCR
• Save scan history
• Organize scans in folders
• Sort scans by date
• Search text in saved scans
• Share images directly to extract text
• Quick access to camera, gallery, or PDF import via long-press on app icon
• Automatically copy extracted text or save it as a TXT file for faster workflow

Get Text Scanner today and start extracting text from documents and images with ease!

Optional Premium plans are available for unlimited scans and extra features.
